definitions.explanation: The screen a mobile phone shows when it is switched on but not in use, and by extension the picture set as its background. Often shortened to {待|ま}ち{受|う}け.

examples.japanese: {待|ま}ち{受|う}け{画面|がめん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{変|か}えた→変える：01089_kaeru⟧。
{待|ま}ち{受|う}け{画面|がめん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{猫|ねこ}→猫：02237_neko⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧だ。
examples.english: My lock-screen picture is a photo of a cat.

examples.japanese: ⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{待|ま}ち{受|う}け{画面|がめん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧な⟦アイドル→アイドル：05111_aidoru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧になっていた。
examples.english: My friend's phone wallpaper was a photo of the idol she likes.

notes:
From {待|ま}ち{受|う}け (standby, from ⟦{待|ま}ち{受|う}ける→待ち受ける：32443_machiukeru⟧, to wait for) + ⟦{画面|がめん}→画面：04406_gamen⟧ (screen). The word dates from flip phones; with smartphones people also say ⟦ロック→ロック：08116_rokku⟧⟦{画面|がめん}→画面：04406_gamen⟧ (lock screen) and ⟦ホーム→ホーム：00113_hoomu⟧⟦{画面|がめん}→画面：04406_gamen⟧ (home screen), and the picture itself is the ⟦{壁紙|かべがみ}→壁紙：16077_kabegami⟧ (wallpaper).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {待|ま}ち{受|う}け⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to set (a picture) as one's wallpaper
- {待|ま}ち{受|う}け{画面|がめん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{設定|せってい}→設定：04767_settei⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to set the standby screen
- ⟦{待|ま}ち{受|う}け→待ち受ける：32443_machiukeru⟧⟦{画像|がぞう}→画像：13549_gazou⟧: wallpaper image
